messages.subject: Adegenet 2.1.2 seppop is broken!!!
messages.body_plain:
Hi,

I just noticed (actually our postdoc Russell Dinnage) that adegenet 2.1.2 has an error within the seppop function (and some dartR functions do use seppop currently, see below).

Be aware gl.filter.callrate works if you do not use the method="pop". Same for some other functions.

The error is nasty because Instead of a list of all population seperated it returns a list of of all the populations unchanged. Hence all the function above do not work with

Adegenet 2.1.2, but do not show an error.

We notified the adegenet guys to correct the error. Until then I advise to "downgrade" to version adegenet 2.1.1, which works as intended.

To downgrade the easiest way is to delete the package from your library folder and type:

library(devtools)
install_version("adegenet", version = "2.1.1", repos = "http://cran.us.r-project.org")
